part: Part I: The Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance
title: Functions of the Commission and performance procedures
content: (4) The Commission shall conduct inquiry in accordance with the provisions of this Article and of any law enacted in that behalf by the Parliament, and shall inquire into the conduct of any person concerned or of any institution concerned whenever the President directs to conduct inquiry; likewise, except as the President directs the Commission not to conduct investigation the Commission may conduct investigation whenever it deems necessary to inquire into the conduct of any person concerned, or any institution concerned with the provisions of this Article who is suspected or which is suspected to have abused the authority of his office, misused the authority of his office or the functions of such institution or for violation of human rights and principles of good governance.
subArticles: (4) The Commission shall conduct inquiry... or for violation of human rights and principles of good governance.

source.notes: Restored 'governance.' at end of sub-article (4) from PDF 'constitution.pdf'. Previous version was cut off at 'principles of good'.
